Woman faces 9 charges after stolen Broward Sheriff's cruiser found on I-95 in St. Lucie County
source_headlines: Stolen Broward deputy's car found on I-95 in St. Lucie County, woman arrested - WPEC
novel_facts: Vehicle stolen shortly after 9 p.m. from Public Safety Building parking area in Fort Lauderdale
Detailed drone and body camera video of arrest
Complete list of charges including grand theft, unlawful use of police badge, possession of weapon/ammunition by convicted felon, drug paraphernalia, driving with suspended license, resisting officer
Perimeter established due to concerns suspect had access to firearm
K-9 unit and drone resources deployed
Internal Affairs investigating to determine if agency policy was violated
Confirmation nothing was missing from the vehicle
Deputy was on duty when vehicle was reported missing
